text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ch1\u003E\u003C\/h1\u003E\u003Ch2\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Bungee;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003E1. Cortical Stroke:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003EA cortical stroke occurs in the outer layer of the brain [cerebral cortex] which is responsible for higher order brain functions, like thinking, perception, and voluntary movements\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Symptoms - often involve changes in sensory perception, motor control, and cognition.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Depending on the specific area of the cortex affected, patients may experience symptoms like :\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003Eaphasia (language problems)\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003Eapraxia (motor coordination difficulties)\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003Eagnosia (impaired recognition of objects or people).\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Ch2\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Bungee;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003E2. Subcortical Stroke:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Subcortical strokes occur in the deeper regions of the brain [ beneath the cerebral cortex] . These areas are responsible for regulating and coordinating basic functions such as movement, sensation, and some aspects of consciousness.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Symptoms - \u0026nbsp;can be more related to motor control and may include muscle weakness\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003EMemory impairment\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003EApathy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Ch2\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d5a6bd; font-family: Bungee;\"\u003EINVOLVEMENT OF ACA [VS] \u0026nbsp;MCA [VS ] PCA-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Ch2 style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E1. Middle Cerebral Artery (MCA)-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;symptoms may often affect the opposite side causing weakness or paralysis of the face and arm.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;sensory changes in the opposite side\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;speech and language problems, like aphasia.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003ECognitive and emotional changes.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EVisual disturbances.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Ci\u003E2. Anterior Cerebral Artery (ACA)-\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;This can lead to contralateral leg weakness and sensory loss.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;changes in motor function, especially in the lower extremities.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E3. Posterior Cerebral Artery (PCA) -\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Results in visual disturbances, such as homonymous hemianopia (loss of vision on the same side in both eyes).\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;memory problems .\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003Ealtered consciousness\u003C\/span\u003E.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; min-height: 22px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E1. Increased Stress on Blood Vessels- \u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003EHigh blood pressure puts excessive force on the walls of blood vessels, especially the small arteries in the brain. Over time, this can damage and weaken the blood vessel walls.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E2. Atherosclerosis-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E \u0026nbsp;Hypertension can lead to the development of atherosclerosis, a condition where fatty deposits build up inside arteries. This can narrow the blood vessels, reducing blood flow to the brain.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E3. Formation of Blood Clots-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E The turbulent blood flow caused by high blood pressure can result in the formation of blood clots in the narrowed or damaged blood vessels. These clots can block blood flow to parts of the brain.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E4. Hemorrhagic Strokes\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E- Uncontrolled hypertension can weaken blood vessel walls to the point of rupture, causing a hemorrhagic stroke. This type of stroke occurs when a blood vessel in the brain bursts, leading to bleeding in the brain tissue.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E5. Reduced Oxygen Supply-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E High blood pressure can decrease the supply of oxygen and nutrients to brain cells, increasing the risk of damage to the brain.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-stretch: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: normal; margin: 0px; text-align: start;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003E6. Damage to Small Blood Vessels-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E Chronic hypertension can lead to the gradual damage of small blood vessels throughout the brain, which can result in cerebral small vessel The symptoms are-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E1. Skin may be cold and pale, or even discolored.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003EWHY METHYLPREDNISOLONE WAS GIVEN?\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003EMethylprednisolone works by suppressing the immune system and reduces inflammation, which reduces the \u0026nbsp;symptoms and prevents the progression of the conditions.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;In cases of severe infections, it may lead to septic shock. Hence \u0026nbsp;Methylprednisolone was administered to reduce the excessive inflammatory response.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E[SIRS criteria include two or more of the following]-\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Fever or hypothermia\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Elevated heart rate\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Rapid breathing\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E3) Sepsis-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EIn this stage, there may be organ dysfunction, but it's not as severe as in severe sepsis or septic shock.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E4) Severe Sepsis-\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ESevere sepsis is characterized by organ dysfunction, often involving the heart, lungs, kidneys, liver, or blood clotting.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E5) Septic Shock-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ESeptic shock is the most critical and life-threatening stage of sepsis. It occurs when there's a severe drop in blood pressure, which can lead to multiple organ failure.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ELevel 3:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EApplication:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EIt is applying the level 1 and 2 knowledge so as to provide a holistic approach of treatment to the patient.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: \u0026quot;Bebas Neue\u0026quot;; font-size: x-large; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECAUSES OF METABOLIC ACIDOSIS-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1. Increased Acid Production\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Excessive Ketone Production. Ketones are acidic, leading to a decrease in blood pH.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Lactic acidosis can occur when there's an overproduction of lactic acid. This can result from issues like poor tissue oxygenation, as seen in severe infections, shock, etc.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2. Decreased Acid Excretion\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Renal Dysfunction\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3. Loss of Bicarbonate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Gastrointestinal Disorders- Conditions like severe diarrhea or a loss of bicarbonate-rich fluids from the digestive tract can lead to metabolic acidosis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E4. Toxic Ingestions or Medications\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ELevel 4:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAnalysis\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: large;\"\u003EAcute pyelonephritis is a type of urinary tract infection (UTI) that specifically affects the kidneys.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: large;\"\u003E1. Symptoms-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: large;\"\u003ESymptoms of acute pyelonephritis may include high fever, chills, back pain, flank pain (pain on the side of the lower back), frequent urination, pain or discomfort during urination, cloudy or bloody urine, and general malaise. It can also cause nausea and vomiting.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Bebas Neue; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003EINDICATIONS FOR DIALYSIS-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1. End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is often due to conditions like chronic kidney disease, diabetes, or hypertension.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2. Severe Acute Kidney Injury (AKI)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;In some cases of severe and sudden kidney damage, temporary dialysis might be necessary until the kidneys recover their function.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3.
